info.title: Shongre API
info.summary: The one authoritative public HTTP contract for every Shongre client.
info.description: OpenAPI-first contract for Web, iOS, Android, administration, and approved integrations. The versioned server base is /api/v1. Generated artifacts are read-only; changes begin in this file.

CookieAuth.name: shongre_access
CookieAuth.description: HttpOnly Web session cookie. Unsafe methods also require the double-submit CSRF header.

RequestId.name: X-Request-Id
RequestId.description: Caller correlation id. The server returns the accepted or generated value.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Strongly recommended for retryable financial and import mutations. Reusing a key with a different payload is a conflict.

JsonValue.description: A JSON-compatible payload whose domain representation is mapped by the owning service adapter.

x-shongre-contract.compatibilityPolicy: Additive changes remain in v1. Breaking changes require a new major server base and a published migration window.
x-shongre-contract.deprecationPolicy: Deprecated operations declare deprecated=true and sunset metadata, have an owner and removal issue, and are removed only after every repository consumer migrates.
